\[
E(p) = 255 \;\text{ if }\; v(p) < 0 \;\text{ and }\; \exists\, q \in N_4(p) : v(q) > 0,\; v(q) - v(p) > T
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(v\): The value minus the zero level
- \(N_4(p)\): The four neighbors of p
- \(T\): The threshold

v is the value minus the zero level, N_4(p) the four neighbors of p and T the threshold. A pixel is marked when it is negative and a neighbor is positive with a jump above T. Only the negative side of each crossing is marked, so the lines are one pixel thick. Other detectors mark the side closer to zero, or both sides. This is the rule used here.
